read.thesis: Grasberg restart is phased from Q2 2026 with 2026 copper sales guided to 3.4bn lb versus 3.6bn lb in 2025, and unit costs guided to $1.75/lb, while capex is trimmed to $4.3bn and Bagdad expansion decision is deferred to 2026.

utilisation.quote: Fourth-quarter 2025 production of 640 million pounds was significantly below fourth-quarter 2024 production of 1.0 billion pounds

capex.quote: FCX is carefully managing costs and near-term capital expenditures in connection with revised operating plans at the Grasberg minerals district

triggers.label: Capex 2026 $4.3bn, major projects $3.0bn
triggers.quote: Capital expenditures are expected to approximate $4.3 billion for the year 2026, including $3.0 billion for major mining projects.

triggers.label: Q4 copper output 640Mlb vs 1,041Mlb
triggers.quote: fourth-quarter 2025 production of 640 million pounds was significantly below fourth-quarter 2024 production of 1.0 billion pounds

triggers.label: 2026 unit cost $1.75/lb, Q1 $2.60
triggers.quote: Unit net cash costs are expected to average $1.75 per pound of copper for the year 2026

triggers.label: Q4 realised copper $5.33/lb
triggers.quote: Average realized prices were $5.33 per pound for copper

triggers.label: Bagdad expansion decision in 2026
triggers.quote: is updating these studies in advance of a potential investment decision during 2026

guidance.quote: Consolidated sales are expected to approximate 3.4 billion pounds of copper, 0.8 million ounces of gold and 90 million pounds of molybdenum for the year 2026
Unit net cash costs are expected to average $1.75 per pound of copper for the year 2026
Capital expenditures are expected to approximate $4.3 billion for the year 2026, including $3.0 billion for major mining projects.
Operating cash flows would approximate $8 billion, including $1 billion of working capital and other sources, for the year 2026

red_flags.label: Grasberg mud rush: PTFI Block Cave suspended since Sep 2025
red_flags.quote: the temporary suspension of operations at the Grasberg Block Cave underground mine since September 2025

red_flags.label: Net debt rising, insurance deductible $0.5bn
red_flags.quote: PTFI is seeking recovery of damages under its property and business interruption insurance policies, which cover up to $1.0 billion in losses
